decisions.reason: Assigning the marketing site to get.drivereel.example does not change the existing requirement that the root domain continue serving the customer-facing product.
The selected marketing-site hostname does not change the Webflow Basic plan or the cost-selection rule.
The dealer login destination at admin.drivereel.example/login remains unchanged by selection of a separate marketing-site subdomain.
The marketing-site hostname does not change the contact form's recipient email addresses or lead-delivery behavior.
The DriveReel name overlap is incidental; the new subdomain does not alter the hero image, depicted controls, gallery, or device presentation.
Selecting the marketing-site hostname does not change the requested Loom instruction recording or its maintenance-training purpose.
The subdomain selection does not change the requirement to transfer the Webflow website to the client's workspace.
The early-access button's destination remains the contact page containing the form; the source decision only specifies the site's hostname.
The selected subdomain does not change the landing page's content composition or screenshot-selection policy.
The marketing-site hostname does not alter the approved clean minimal SaaS aesthetic, brand-asset use, or Loom style reference.
